name: Carbon Knight
source:
A world devastated by the battle of gods. The surviving people created inanimate "carbon humans" by using the relics of Gods and sealing the soul within. For several hundred years the war lasted. Now carbon knight needs to deter the restoration of the once sealed demon king. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个被神之战摧毁的世界。幸存的人们利用神的遗物创造了无生命的“碳基人”，并将灵魂封印其中。战争持续了数百年。如今碳基骑士需要阻止曾被封印的魔王复活。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
